_comment: DSN-COUPLE-01 PREVENTIVE — vsf-clima-kernel (future Rust component of s1-clima, LXC 112). Current implementation is Python (vsf-clima-l0/l1/l2/l3 systemd services — not scanned by OUR_BIN_RE). This manifest pre-declares the system contract so that when a Rust component ships, the reconciler finds it declared rather than orphaned. Deploy: copy to /etc/vsf/coupling/ on n02 host. Update binary_sha when first Rust binary ships.

identity._note: kind=python_service now. Change to rust_service + set binary_sha when Rust kernel arrives.

identity_proof._note: binary_sha to_calibrate — update when first Rust component (vsf-clima-kernel) ships. Current Python services: vsf-clima-l0, vsf-clima-l1@*, vsf-clima-l2@*, vsf-clima-l3@* (23 units).

sensors.name: stasis_cos
sensors._why: primary viability signal for S3 resource bargain

omega.note: S1 climate domain — 12 Ω zones (Fierro Q1-Q3 certified). stasis_cos=exp(-||z||) is the viability metric. 23 systemd services (L0+L1x2+L2x7+L3x12+L3x1-extras).

channels.phi_up: vsf.clima.continental.phi_up (NATS — system-level aggregate, what S3 acts on)

auth.source: /etc/default/vsf-clima on LXC 112 (EnvironmentFile=, NATS_URL=nats://<token>@10.10.20.20:4222), applied to all clima systemd unit templates: vsf-clima-l0, l1@, l2@, l3@, vsf-s4-markov-project
auth.verify: journalctl -u vsf-s4-markov-project --since -1h shows '[markov] projected N zones' lines (not 'Authorization Violation'); s4_markov_projection.json on LXC 101 has an mtime newer than the last kernel tick. Filled in 2026-07-26 after this exact requirement went undeclared and unmet for an unknown period — the pipeline was silently dead until PHI-UP-PIPELINE diagnosis found the missing token.
